name: Prateek Parihar
body_paragraphs: I am writing to apply for the Associate Insights Analyst role within the Personal Bank Remediation team at ASB. I like the clarity of purpose in this role, using data to identify where things went wrong for customers and helping put it right.

In my current role at AA New Zealand, I work daily with operational data to trace root causes and keep reporting accurate and consistent. Before that, at Wipro, I validated healthcare data structures using SQL and Power BI within strict governance standards.
I would welcome the opportunity to talk through how I could contribute to the team. Thank you for considering my application.
